purpose: The secondary-screen top strip: a focusable back chevron, the page title and the status line actions write into. It carries no plate; the pack wall shows through.

anatomy.note: h2, 30dp bold, 18dp after the back stop.
End-aligned meta line; actions write sentences here, never toasts.

rules: Back is the first stop; DOWN from it goes to the first row.

platformDeltas.ios: Navigation bar with a leading chevron and trailing status caption.
platformDeltas.windows: Back button plus title in the app chrome; keyboard Esc mirrors Back.
